title: MUIS' Use of Digital Social Media and Asatizah Recognition Scheme to Combat Trend of Online Radicalisation
what_it_is: MUIS' Use of Digital Social Media and Asatizah Recognition Scheme to Combat Trend of Online Radicalisation

sections.label: MUIS online Islamic media platforms
sections.summary: MUIS runs MuslimSG and SalamSG TV and works with influencers to promote mainstream, contextualised Islam.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: MuslimSG is a one-stop online media platform by MUIS that provides Islamic religious content.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: MUIS leverages SalamSG TV and MuslimSG, as well as collaborates with key influencers to promote mainstream, contextualised Islam.

sections.label: SalamSG TV, MuslimSG, mysafespace.sg audiences
sections.summary: Most 2022 Facebook audiences were aged 13 to 44; mysafespace.sg is a ground-up asatizah chat portal MUIS funds through AYN training.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: For SalamSG TV, 63.2% of its Facebook audience in 2022 were between the ages of 13 and 44 years old; and for MuslimSG, 70.9% of its Facebook audience in 2022 were between the ages of 13 and 44 years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The hon Member raised mysafespace.sg, which is a chat portal that connects asatizah to those who wish to seek guidance on religious matters anonymously.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: This is a ground-up initiative by a group of asatizah and MUIS is not directly involved.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: However, most of the asatizah on mysafespace.sg are from the Asatizah Youth Network (AYN), which was formed by MUIS to engage youth in our community via social media.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: MUIS supports the AYN, by funding training in areas, such as developing positive counter-narratives, curating digital content as well as youth-specific counselling skills.

sections.label: Committee on Future Asatizah
sections.summary: COFA was formed in 2019 to develop a vision for future asatizah, and MUIS remains committed to its recommendations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In 2019, the Committee on Future Asatizah (COFA) was formed to develop a vision for the asatizah of the future.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In line with their recommendations to achieve this vision, MUIS remains committed to professionalise the asatizah sector, strengthen our religious institutions and nurture inspiring religious graduates.
